title: Track
intro: Your own location history from TravTrack, day by day — for you only, never shared.

day.label: Day
day.empty: Nothing was recorded on this day.
day.truncated: This day holds more positions than one view shows — the line is incomplete.

timeline.title: The day
timeline.none: TravStats knows of no entry, no trip and no time at home on this day.

export.title: Export the history
export.intro: Downloads your TravTrack positions of these days, both included, on your profile's clock. What a privacy zone hides is not in the file.
export.gpx: GPX — for map and sports apps
export.json: JSON — everything, with pauses and deleted spans
export.truncated: This span holds more positions than one file carries. Part {{part}} is downloaded — “Export the rest” downloads the next part.
export.doneParts: All {{count}} parts were downloaded — together, the whole span.
export.truncatedNoRest: The file ends early, and the server does not say where the rest begins. Export a shorter span.

delete.title: Delete a span
delete.intro: Deletes every position of these days, both included, on your profile's clock. The span stays deleted: not even a phone that was still offline brings them back. Flights and trips stay.
delete.previewNone: Nothing is stored in this span.

errors.disabled: TravTrack is switched off on this server. What is stored can still be exported and deleted under Settings → Location.
errors.exportTooLong: An export covers at most 366 days. Pick a shorter span.
errors.zoneLimit: You already have as many privacy zones as there can be.
errors.network: The server cannot be reached right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.generic: That did not work. Try again.
errors.rangeTooLong: A range on the map covers at most 400 days. Pick a shorter one.
errors.pointGone: This position no longer exists – it has already been deleted.
errors.legInvalid: This leg cannot be changed like that.
errors.legGone: This leg no longer exists – the view is being recalculated.
errors.stopInvalid: This stop cannot be named like that.
errors.stopGone: This stop no longer exists – the view is being recalculated.

settings.tripsNoResidence: TravTrack recognises trips only once your home is confirmed: it measures the distance from where you live. Confirm it under Settings → Home.

diagnostics.deleteConfirm: Delete the whole diagnostics log of every device? Stored positions stay.
diagnostics.noLog: The phone sent no diagnostics log for this day. Switch it on in the Companion under Settings → Location.
diagnostics.noGaps: Nothing is missing this day: no gap of 10 minutes or more.
diagnostics.truncated: This day's log is longer than the list. The gaps are still worked out from the whole log; everything is in the download.
diagnostics.barsLabel: Stored positions and fixes the phone reported, per hour
diagnostics.legend: Teal: stored positions · Grey: fixes the phone received from iOS

cause.reportedGap: The phone reported this gap itself.
cause.permission: Location access was not set to “Always”.
cause.lostAfterUpload: The phone recorded and uploaded positions, but nothing is stored for this time: dropped by the server, inside a privacy zone, or deleted later.
cause.uploadFailed: The phone recorded positions, but the upload failed.
cause.notUploaded: The phone recorded positions but has not uploaded them yet.
cause.droppedOnPhone: iOS delivered fixes, but the phone dropped them.
cause.noLog: No diagnostics log for this time.
cause.unexplained: The phone received no fix, and the log shows no reason (iOS probably suspended the app or delivered nothing).

evidence.autoPause: iOS was allowed to pause recording automatically (auto-pause) – the likeliest cause here, but the app is not told when it happens
evidence.stopPlan: The app ended the recording itself (plan, {{where}}). Verdicts: flight {{flight}}, trip {{trip}}, everyday {{everyday}}. Location access allowed: {{allowed}}, everyday switch: {{enabled}}, everyday running: {{armed}}, server decision: {{decision}}.

reported.zonesUnknown: Privacy zones were not loaded yet

imports.title: Track files
imports.intro: A track file goes into your TravTrack history: GPX, KML or TCX from a sports app or a tracker, GeoJSON with times, and the Google location history (Takeout “Records.json”, “Semantic Location History” or the on-device Timeline export). The file is read on this server only. Times without a time zone are not guessed, and a missing accuracy stays unknown. Positions inside a privacy zone or a deleted span are discarded, and what is stored already is not added twice. An import starts no suggestions.
imports.cancelled: The import was deleted before it finished.

status.interrupted: interrupted (the server restarted) – import the file again
status.paused: paused – resume it under “Copy your Dawarich history”

imports.deleteConfirm_one: Delete the import “{{name}}” and its {{count}} position? Positions from other sources stay.
imports.deleteConfirm_other: Delete the import “{{name}}” and its {{count}} positions? Positions from other sources stay.

errors.noTimes: The file holds no times – without a time a position is no history. Export it as a recording (track), not as a route.
errors.unreadable: The file is not a readable track file (GPX, KML, TCX, Google location history, GeoJSON), it is unfinished, or too large to read.
errors.unsupportedFormat: The import cannot read FIT files yet. Export the activity as GPX or TCX.
errors.running: An import is running already. Wait until it has finished.
errors.busy: The server is reading other files right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.tooLarge: The file is too large – 25 MB at most for GPX, KML and TCX, 200 MB for Google location history and GeoJSON.
errors.rateLimited: Too many imports in a short time. Try again in a quarter of an hour.
errors.lost: Whether the import finished is not known – the server restarted. Check the list.
errors.tooManyPoints: The file holds too many positions – one import takes at most 200,000 from GPX and 2 million from the other formats. Split it, say by month.

dawarichCopy.title: Copy your Dawarich history
dawarichCopy.intro: Copies your location history from your own Dawarich into TravTrack – all of it or a span of days. Dawarich is only read: nothing there is changed or deleted, and your location source stays as it is. Positions inside a privacy zone or a deleted span are discarded, and what is stored already is not added twice. The copy starts no suggestions; you delete it like an import.

connection.none: Connect your own Dawarich first (Settings → Dawarich). Only then can the history be copied.
connection.shared: This server only has a shared Dawarich set up. A copy reads from your own only – enter your own connection for it.

status.interrupted: Interrupted (the server restarted), goes on from {{day}}
status.incomplete: Copied, but incomplete – what is missing is listed below

reason.notFound: Dawarich does not know the path – check the address
reason.notConfigured: Your own Dawarich connection is missing

errors.notConfigured: This needs your own Dawarich connection (Settings → Dawarich).
errors.running: An import or a copy is running already. Wait until it is done, or pause the copy.
errors.notResumable: This copy cannot be resumed – start a new one.
errors.range: That span does not work: it needs a start and an end, cannot lie in the future, and reaches back twenty years at most.
errors.rateLimited: Too many starts in a short time. Try again in a quarter of an hour.
errors.paused: Resume the paused copy or delete it first.

sources.title: Further sources
sources.intro: OwnTracks (Android, iOS) and Overland (iOS) can send positions straight to TravTrack. Each device gets its own key, which can deliver positions and nothing else – it reads nothing and opens no other page.
sources.privacy: Unlike the Companion app, these apps cannot know your privacy zones: positions inside a privacy zone reach the server and are only discarded there.
sources.label: Device
sources.shownOnce: The key is shown only now. Enter it in the app; afterwards it cannot be seen here again.

owntracks.howTo: In OwnTracks: Settings → Connection → mode "HTTP". Enter the URL, switch authentication on, use any name as the user and the key as the password.

overland.howTo: In Overland: Settings → "Receiver Endpoint" is the URL, "Access Token" the key. Overland sends it in the Authorization header.

sources.revokeConfirm: Revoke the key "{{name}}"? The device can send nothing afterwards; what it sent stays.

errors.notActive: Further sources are only available while TravTrack is your location source (Settings → Location).
errors.limit: You already hold as many keys as there may be. Revoke one first.
errors.rateLimited: Too many keys were created just now. Try again in a quarter of an hour.

explored.legend: Each square is about 1–2 km across: a place where your history holds at least one position on the ground.
explored.zones: Privacy zones are shown as explored.
explored.zoomIn: There are too many explored squares here for one view. Zoom in closer.
explored.unavailable: The explored map is not available for privacy zones this large.
explored.partial: Not every place service was reachable – the list may be incomplete.
explored.preparing: The explored map is being prepared. Check back in a few minutes.

months.empty: Your history holds no positions in {{year}}.
months.pending: Being recomputed right now – the values may still change.
months.legend: Kilometres on the ground count only the visible line: nothing in the air, nothing faster than 500 km/h, nothing a privacy zone hides. Months without positions are left out.
months.citiesOff: The overview names cities only once you switch on the city lookup in the settings.
months.utc: Months in UTC: a day counts in the month it falls in by UTC – what happens around local midnight may appear in the neighbouring month.
months.chartTitle: Distance on the ground per month ({{unit}})
months.chartNote: Months without positions and months being computed have no bar.

map.zonesNeverDrawn: Private zones are left out and never drawn
map.rangeEmpty: Nothing was recorded on these days.

live.failed: Following live is not working right now: {{reason}}

layers.heatHint: Where you spend a lot of time
layers.photosHint: From Immich, placed on the track
layers.dayOnly: Only in the day and 7-day views
layers.countriesHint: Countries with location points in the months the range touches – no proof of a visit

route.title: Routes
route.split: Split a route after a pause of
route.notRemembered: Couldn't remember this choice – it only holds until you leave the page.

point.title: Position
point.deleteConfirm: Delete this one position for good? Importing the same file again will not bring it back.

totals.title: Summary
totals.note: Counted within a route only — never across a gap, zone or pause. Moving means faster than 3 km/h.

map.rangePartFailed: After {{percent}} % a part did not arrive: {{reason}} What is already here stays visible.
map.rangeSimplified: For this range the line is simplified, so the distance is a little shorter than measured.
map.rangeOmitted_one: {{count}} short piece no longer fitted into the view and is missing.
map.rangeOmitted_other: {{count}} short pieces no longer fitted into the view and are missing.
map.rangeNoTimeline: For month, year and range the map shows the line alone. The day's timeline, stays and logbook entries are in the day and 7-day views.

countries.none: No country was determined in the months touched.

failure.unreachable: Immich cannot be reached right now.

failure.notFound: Immich no longer knows these photos.

start.title: How data gets into TravTrack
start.intro: TravTrack is switched on, but your account holds nothing yet. Three ways bring your location history here:

companion.title: Record with the Companion
companion.body: Set your location source to TravTrack (Settings → Location history → Location source). The Companion then records your ways here.
companion.done: TravTrack is your location source. As soon as the Companion records, your ways appear here.

dawarich.title: Copy your Dawarich history
dawarich.body: Copies your existing history from Dawarich into TravTrack. Nothing in Dawarich is changed.

gpx.title: Import a GPX file
gpx.body: Loads tracks from a GPX file, for example from a sports app or a GPS device.

start.pairing: No Companion paired yet: under Settings → Account → Devices TravStats shows a QR code you scan with the app.

legs.title: Legs
legs.reloadFailed: Saved, but the view could not be reloaded. Reload the page.
